verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page claims AI agents "collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule," which matches the core of the story. Docs show connected-system integrations that monitor AWS, GitHub and Google Workspace, and a daily automated code scan. However, the scheduled evidence-collection claim rests on a single marketing tagline, and the integration docs describe monitoring rather than evidence artifacts. Missing for 10: first-party docs on how scheduled evidence collection works and how often it runs, timestamped artifacts or audit-ready output, explicit replacement of manual screenshots and CSV uploads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
